title: Phantom Storage
description: Summon an ender chest-like container that follows you around!
body:
**Phantom Storage** adds a semi-transparent floating chest that follows you around, keeps your items accessible at all times, and can automatically push and pull items to and from storage blocks in the world.

- **The Phantom Chest**

Summon it with the Phantom Chest Summoner item. The chest hovers near you, follows you through the world, and opens like any normal chest — only the player who summoned it can access it. Dismiss it with the same item.

The chest GUI has three tabs:
- Chest — 54-slot personal inventory
- Craft — embedded 3×3 crafting grid with JEI integration; click recipes directly in from JEI
- Void Filter — 9-slot ghost filter; any item type placed here is silently destroyed when it enters the chest, keeping your inventory clean

- **The Phantom Wrench**

Craft a Phantom Wrench to link nearby storage blocks to your chest. Shift+Right-click a chest, barrel, or any other storage block to link it as an OUTPUT — your Phantom Chest will push items there automatically. Sneak+right-click to switch it to INPUT (chest pulls items from there) or unlink it entirely.

- Works with modded storage blocks that expose the IItemHandler capability (Sophisticated Storage, etc.)
- Configured links are saved to your player data — you can set up your storage layout before ever summoning the chest
- While holding the wrench, linked blocks are highlighted: orange for OUTPUT, blue for INPUT. A transparent box shows the range the chest must be within for transfers to happen
- Up to 16 linked storages per chest
- Link count is always visible in the HUD while holding the wrench
